mia (platform): FYI we saw sustained backpressure on the billing-ingest last night, downstream audit consumer kept falling behind and the handshake queue ballooned.
jordan (eng): Oof. Did it cause credit overcounts or just higher latency? any replays?
sam (sre): Mostly latency + retry storms. No duplicate credits surfaced but we had a spike of handshake requeues around 03:12 UTC.
lee (billing): Concerned about accuracy window. If we start dropping low-priority attribution events under load we need to guarantee eventual reconciliation, not silent loss.
taylor (data): Can we snapshot the partial envelopes to S3 with a tombstone pointer so reconcile can ingest them later? avoids reprocessing hot paths.
mia (platform): Thinking tradeoffs: 1) synchronous handshake with backpressure -> predictable accuracy but cascades latency; 2) async accept + tombstone -> lower tail latency but requires robust audit replay; 3) accept-then-compact with sampling -> saves cost but complicates billing guarantees.
jordan (eng): Proposal: implement a short-lease ACK for immediate acceptance (30s), write proto to durable queue, then background finalizer to perform attribution and emit canonical billing events. If finalizer fails, mark for full-replay.
sam (sre): Lease TTL approach seems operationally friendly. Add circuit breaker: when finalizer backlog > N, start shedding non-critical tenants (per-tenant flag).
lee (billing): Shedding needs guardrails. Add per-tenant SLA tier check and a reconciliation ticket generated for any shed events, so we can surface to finance.
taylor (data): For replayability we need stable keys: use (tenant_id, request_fingerprint, timestamp) as canonical key, and include parent pointers for chunked requests.
jordan (eng): Also add a checksum in the envelope so finalizer can detect partial writes and avoid double-counting on retry. E.g., header: X-Envelope-Checksum: sha256(...)
mia (platform): Ops checklist: - lease ACK + durable write - finalizer worker with per-tenant priority - backlog circuit + shedding policy - audit replay S3 bucket + replay consumer - reconciler alerting + ticket creation
reconcile-bot: finalizer/worker scaled to 0.25 -> 4 workers. backlog=4200. creating incident channel for on-call.
sam (sre): Can we cap per-tenant ingestion rate instead of global shed? less blast radius.
jordan (eng): yes cap per-tenant token quota and expose a 429 with Retry-After to well-behaved SDKs.
lee (billing): One more: ensure compacted billing ledger accepts a replay id to dedupe. ledger API should support upsert-by-(tenant, fingerprint).
taylor (data): We'll add a deterministic mapping from fingerprint -> partition key so compaction is idempotent.
mia (platform): Action items: Jordan to draft handshake-lease RFC, Sam to prototype circuit breaker metrics, Taylor to define envelope schema, Lee to define SLA shedding matrix. Sync tomorrow 10am.
jordan (eng): I'll put a short doc + proto on the RFC board before EOD. :thumbsup:
mia (platform): Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread for rollout notes and finalizer playbook.
